title: Talk-only intro
description: No targets: the card sits under the camera and you page with the hotkey. For talking-head intros or plain screen recordings.

steps.say: Hi, I'm going to show you how we record product demos without reading from a second screen.
The lines sit right under the camera, so your eyes stay on the lens.
Reading steps move on by themselves once the bar fills up.
And the recording never shows any of it.
